column3: 1. Integrate [protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable,] into broader landscape and seascape planning to improve, in accordance with national legislation, biodiversity outcomes, ecological representativeness and connectivity, through participatory and biodiversity-inclusive spatial planning processes, while recognizing and respecting the rights of indigenous peoples and local communities. [1 bis Additional complementary activities on ecological connectivity.]
column4: 1. 根據國家立法，透過參與式且具生物多樣性包容性的空間規劃程序，將 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地，] 整合至更廣泛的陸域與海域規劃中，以改善生物多樣性成果、生態代表性與連結性，同時認可並尊重原住民族與地方社區之權利。 [1 bis 關於生態連結性的額外補充活動。]

column3: 2. Promote the restoration of degraded ecosystems [within protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable], and beyond, including buffer zones, ecological corridors, [soil biodiversity, in particular fungal biodiversity,8] and inland water ecosystems, with a view to restoring ecological integrity and ecological connectivity across landscapes and seascapes, including through the development of criteria for identifying priority restoration areas and approaches for measuring restoration success, ensuring inclusive and gender-responsive implementation of the restoration efforts[, as appropriate]. [2 bis. Additional complementary activities on ecological connectivity.]
column4: 2. 促進退化生態系之復育，[於保護區與保育共生地內，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地]，及其範圍之外，包括緩衝區、生態廊道、[土壤生物多樣性，特別是真菌生物多樣性，8] 以及內陸水域生態系，旨在恢復跨陸域與海域之生態完整性與生態連結性，包括透過制定識別優先復育區域之標準以及衡量復育成功之方法，並確保復育工作之執行具包容性且對性別敏感[，視情況而定]。 [2 bis. 關於生態連結性的額外補充活動。]

column3: 3. Incorporate the language, scope and timelines of Target 3 of the Framework across implementation of the programme of work, updating relevant timelines and terminology, and ensuring coherence with related processes carried out under the Convention on Biological Diversity, including the programme of work on Article 8(j) and other provisions of the Convention related to indigenous peoples and local communities to 2030.9
column4: 3. 在工作計畫之執行過程中，納入《綱要》目標 3 之用語、範圍與時程，更新相關時程與術語，並確保與《生物多樣性公約》下進行之相關程序保持一致，包括關於第 8(j) 條及公約中其他與原住民族與地方社區相關規定之工作計畫至 2030 年。9

column3: 4. Strengthen guidance related to improving monitoring, reporting and evaluation systems for terrestrial, inland waters, coastal and marine ecosystems to improve the assessment of biodiversity outcomes, including in relation to ecological representativeness, connectivity, integrity, conservation effectiveness, management effectiveness, governance quality, species population trends and through the use of appropriately indicators of the monitoring framework for the Kunming- Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework,10 as well as disaggregated indicators, including, as appropriate, by ecosystem type and level of protection. 5. Enhance guidance related to the recognition, respect, promotion and protection of indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable, in the context of Target 3 of the Framework, in a manner consistent with the programme of work on Article 8(j) and other provisions of the Convention related to indigenous peoples and local communities. This encompasses differentiated approaches to ensure comprehensive protection, including for indigenous peoples in voluntary isolation and initial contact, in line with the principles of no contact, intangibility and precaution, in accordance with national circumstances. 6. Increase the uptake of practical frameworks, guidance, emerging innovative tools, case studies and national experiences, lessons learned and different approaches to support the implementation of Target 3 of the Framework, including the definition and prioritization of areas of particular importance for biodiversity, ecological networks, corridor design for climate adaptation, large‑scale ecological connectivity, including ecological processes below ground, other effective area-based conservation measures and transboundary conservation. 7. Strengthen the operationalization of equitable and effective governance in [the] planning and management [of protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable,] [and a human rights-based approach] consistent with section C of the Framework, including by, as appropriate, shifting from beneficiary‑based approaches to recognizing, respecting, promoting and protecting the rights and contributions of indigenous peoples and local communities; promoting standards and good practices for participation, shared governance and co‑management arrangements; ensuring culturally appropriate access to information; respecting and strengthening, where applicable, the implementation of free, prior and informed consent,11 [consistent with national circumstances and legislation and international instruments]. 8. Strengthen inclusive monitoring, reporting and evaluation systems [for protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable], including by identifying available tools, and facilitate the use of relevant new technologies to better assess ecological representativeness, integrity and connectivity, biodiversity outcomes, management effectiveness, governance quality, species
column4: 4. 強化與改善陸域、內陸水域、沿岸及海洋生態系監測、報告與評估系統相關之指引，以改善生物多樣性成果之評估，包括與生態代表性、連結性、完整性、保育成效、管理成效、治理品質、物種族群趨勢相關之評估，並透過使用昆明－蒙特婁全球生物多樣性綱要監測架構之適當指標，10 以及分項指標，包括視情況依生態系類型與保護等級進行分類。 5. 在綱要目標 3 之脈絡下，強化與承認、尊重、促進及保護原住民族與傳統領地（如適用）相關之指引，其方式應與關於第 8(j) 條之工作計畫，以及公約中與原住民族與地方社區相關之其他條文保持一致。這包括採取差異化方法以確保全面性的保護，包括針對處於自願隔離與初步接觸狀態之原住民族，並應符合不接觸、不可侵犯及預防原則，並視國家情況而定。 6. 增加實務框架、指引、新興創新工具、個案研究、國家經驗、經驗教訓及不同方法之運用，以支持綱要目標 3 之實施，包括對生物多樣性特別重要區域之定義與優先順序劃定、生態網路、因應氣候調適之廊道設計、大規模生態連結性（包括地下生態過程）、保育共生地以及跨境保育。 7. 強化在[該]規劃與管理 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地，] [以及基於人權之方法] 中，公平且有效治理之具體化，且應與綱要 C 節保持一致，包括視情況透過從以受益者為基礎之方法，轉向承認、尊重、促進及保護原住民族與地方社區之權利與貢獻；促進參與、共同治理與共同管理安排之標準與良好實務；確保文化適切之資訊取得；並在適用情況下，尊重並強化自由、事先及知情同意之實施，11 [並與國家情況、國內立法及國際文書保持一致]。 8. 強化具包容性之監測、報告與評估系統 [針對保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地]，包括透過識別可用工具，並促進相關新技術之使用，以更佳地評估生態代表性、完整性與連結性、生物多樣性成果、管理成效、治理品質、物種

column3: population trends, relevant indicators of the monitoring framework, as well as [gender-]disaggregated indicators. 9. Promote the use of relevant and new approaches for ecological integrity and connectivity in the planning and management [of protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable], including through the development of ecological networks, ecological corridors, stepping stones and transboundary connectivity initiatives and corridor design for climate adaptation across wider landscapes and seascapes. 10. Strengthen the integration of climate change considerations into the planning and management of [protected and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable], including ecological corridors. [10 bis. Additional complementary activities on ecological connectivity.]
column4: 族群趨勢、監測架構之相關指標，以及 [性別] 分層指標。 9. 促進在規劃與管理 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地] 時，使用與生態完整性及連結性相關之新方法，包括透過開發生態網路、生態廊道、踏腳石以及跨國界連結倡議，以及針對更廣泛的陸域與海域景觀進行氣候調適之廊道設計。 10. 加強將氣候變遷考量整合至 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地] 之規劃與管理中，包括生態廊道。 [10 bis. 關於生態連結性的額外補充活動。]

column3: 11. Strengthen capacities for planning and management through participatory risk assessment, rapid response mechanisms, where possible, and inclusive community engagements and the integration of traditional knowledge in addressing human-wildlife conflict and promoting coexistence[ in protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable]. 12. Integrate effective management of human-wildlife interactions, including human-wildlife conflict risk assessment, in order to minimize conflict to promote coexistence [in the context of protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable]. [12 bis Additional complementary activities on ecological connectivity.]
column4: 11. 透過參與式風險評估、在可能情況下建立快速反應機制、包容性社區參與，以及在處理人與野生動物衝突與促進共存時整合傳統知識，以強化規劃與管理之能力[於保護區與保育共生地中，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地]。 12. 整合人與野生動物互動之有效管理，包括人與野生動物衝突風險評估，以將衝突降至最低並促進共存 [於保護區與保育共生地之脈絡下，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地]。 [12 bis 關於生態連結性的額外補充活動。]

column3: 13. Address and manage the use of wild species [within protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable,] where such use is allowed, in a manner that mitigates risks to native biodiversity and human health, consistent with site‑specific conservation objectives and zoning, while preventing overexploitation and ensuring sustainable, legal and safe use at all stages, including through participatory biodiversity monitoring and the application of One Health risk assessment frameworks, as appropriate, and respecting and protecting the customary sustainable use practices of indigenous peoples and local communities.
column4: 13. 針對並管理野生物種之利用 [於保護區與保育共生地內，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地，]，在允許此類利用之情況下，應以減輕對原生生物多樣性與人類健康風險之方式進行，並與特定場域之保育目標及分區規劃保持一致，同時防止過度開發，並確保在所有階段皆為永續、合法且安全之利用，包括透過參與式生物多樣性監測以及適當應用健康一體風險評估架構，並尊重且保護原住民族與地方社區之慣習性永續利用實務。

column3: 16. Address pollution pressures[, including plastic pollution, pollution from hazardous substances, pesticide use and run-off, and noise and light pollution,] from all sources [affecting protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable], cumulative impacts and land-sea interactions.
column4: 16. 應對來自所有來源之污染壓力[，包括塑膠污染、有害物質污染、農藥使用與逕流，以及噪音與光污染，][影響保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地]，累積影響及陸海互動。

column3: 17. Strengthen the integration of climate change considerations into the planning and management of [protected and other effective area-based conservation measures and indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable], including ecological corridors, by scaling up related response measures that promote resilience in order to minimize the negative impacts of climate change, while ensuring ecological integrity. 18. Promote system design for climate adaptation and resilience that anticipates future range shifts, including by identifying additional climate refugia, connectivity corridors[, soil biodiversity, in particular fungal biodiversity,] and areas of future biodiversity importance.
column4: 17. 透過擴大相關應對措施以促進韌性，藉此極小化氣候變遷之負面影響，同時確保生態完整性，強化將氣候變遷考量納入 [保護區與保育共生地及原住民族與傳統領地，在適用情況下] 之規劃與管理，包括生態廊道。 18. 推動氣候調適與韌性之系統設計，以預判未來之分布範圍偏移，包括透過識別額外的氣候避難所、連通廊道[、土壤生物多樣性，特別是真菌生物多樣性，] 以及未來具生物多樣性重要性之區域。

column3: 20. Strengthen guidance on the sustainable management of productive landscapes and biodiversity-friendly practices to support[, while being distinguished from,] [protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable,] and improvements in biodiversity, ecological connectivity, ecosystem functions and resilience across landscapes and seascapes, in particular by promoting nature-based solutions and/or ecosystem-based approaches and integrated land-use planning approaches, recognizing the value of traditional knowledge and practices [and ways to distinguish such activities from those that fall under Target 3 of the Framework].
column4: 20. 強化關於生產性景觀之永續管理與生物多樣性友善做法之指引，以支持[，並與之區隔，] [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地，] 以及景觀與海域之生物多樣性、生態連結性、生態系功能與韌性之改善，特別是透過推動以自然為本的解決方案及／或以生態系為本的方法，以及整合性土地利用規劃方法，並認可傳統知識與做法之價值 [以及區分此類活動與屬於綱要目標 3 之活動之方式]。

column3: 21. Highlight the role of [protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable,] in restoring, maintaining and enhancing nature’s contributions to people, including ecosystem functions and services, [including water security, coastal protection, pollinators and food security,] as well as strengthen capacities to measure and value those functions and services.
column4: 21. 強調 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地，] 在復育、維持與增強自然對人類之貢獻（包括生態系功能與服務，[包括水安全、海岸防護、傳粉者與糧食安全，]）方面之角色，並強化衡量與評估該等功能與服務之能力。

[22 bis. Additional complementary activities on ecological connectivity.]
column4: 22. 將 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地，] 整合至都市與近郊規劃中，包括透過綠色與藍色基礎設施，以增強生態連結性、復育、原生種保育與氣候變遷調適，並支持身心健康與福祉，以及自然之公平取得，特別是針對最脆弱族群。 [22 bis. 關於生態連結性之額外補充活動。]

column3: 25. Facilitate clearer direction on engaging financial actors and the private sector [in support of protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable,] on a voluntary basis to develop the field of conservation, protection and restoration as a key economic area.

column4: 30. 促進識別來自所有來源（包括國內、國際、公共與私人資源）之及時、可預測且可取得的財務資源，以確保有效落實並達成長期財務永續性與制度韌性 [針對保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地，] [包括] 依據公約第二十條，以及創新機制（例如公私夥伴關係），特別是為了支持開發中締約方，尤其是其中的低度開發國家與小島嶼開發中國家，且須符合國家優先事項以及環境與社會安全保障。 31. 促進 [直接且] 可取得之資金，用於綱要目標 3 下適用情況下之原住民族與地方社區、女性與青年，並符合國家情況。

Strengthen capacity-building and development, technical and scientific cooperation and technology transfer, on mutually agreed terms, for establishing and managing [protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable], including with respect to new technologies and institutional support for the conservation workforce, such as rangers and other relevant personnel.
column4: 32. 在共同商定條件下，加強能力建構與發展、技術與科學合作以及技術轉移，以建立與管理 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地]，包括針對新技術以及對保育人力（如巡守員及其他相關人員）之制度支持。

column3: 33. Strengthen the application of advances in biodiversity monitoring, data management and knowledge‑sharing through targeted capacity‑building and development on comprehensive biodiversity monitoring and the use of innovative technologies, including digital technologies, remote sensing and national biodiversity databases, to improve monitoring, evaluation, reporting and decision‑making [regarding biodiversity outcomes and ecological connectivity and representativeness, and] relating to [protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable,] including through nationally appropriate approaches and indicators, while strengthening capacities and infrastructure for managing and integrating biodiversity data.
column4: 33. 透過針對性的能力建構，以及針對全面性生物多樣性監測與創新技術（包括數位技術、遙測及國家生物多樣性資料庫）之開發，強化生物多樣性監測、資料管理與知識分享進展之應用，以改善監測、評估、報告與決策 [關於生物多樣性成果、生態連結性與代表性，以及] 涉及 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地，] 之事項，包括透過國家適切之方法與指標，同時強化管理與整合生物多樣性資料之能力與基礎設施。

column3: 34. Strengthen access to information and the full, equitable, inclusive, effective and gender-responsive representation and participation of indigenous peoples and local communities in decision-making [related to protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable]. 35. [Ensure] access to justice by indigenous peoples and local communities, women, children, youth and persons with disabilities[, including through the establishment of effective and accessible grievance mechanisms,] in accordance with national legislation and other relevant international agreements, to address issues related to the establishment, management and governance of [protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable]. 36. [Ensure] the full protection of environmental human rights defenders engaged in activities related to [protected areas and other effective area-based conservation measures, recognizing indigenous and traditional territories, where applicable].
column4: 34. 強化原住民族與地方社區在決策中取得資訊之管道，以及完整、公平、包容、有效且具性別回應之代表性與參與 [與保護區及保育共生地相關，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地]。 35. [確保] 原住民族與地方社區、女性、兒童、青年及身心障礙者能依據國家立法及其他相關國際協議，獲得司法救濟[，包括透過建立有效且易於取得的申訴機制，]以處理與建立、管理及治理 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地] 相關之議題。 36. [確保] 全面保護從事與 [保護區與保育共生地，在適用情況下，認可原住民族與傳統領地] 相關活動之環境人權捍衛者。

column3: 37. Promote gender equality and integrate a gender-responsive approach, including the use of [indicators disaggregated by sex][gender-disaggregated indicators], across the programme of work[, taking gender-based violence into due consideration].
column4: 37. 促進性別平等並整合性別回應之方法，包括使用 [按性別分類之指標][性別分層指標]，貫穿整個工作計畫[，並適當考慮性別暴力]。
